grammar: 我們學習用 How do you feel? 和 I feel…because… 來表達感受與原因。
intro_zh: 在這堂課裡，我們會學習用英文說出自己的感受，並說明為什麼會有這種心情。透過生活情境，練習問答和描述，讓英語表達更自然吧。
can_do: 能用 How do you feel? 問別人的感受
能用 I feel…because… 說出自己的感受和原因
能在簡短對話中描述運動、興趣和習慣時使用本課單字

sentences.en: Today is Saturday, and Lily feels nervous because she has a baseball game.
sentences.zh: 今天是星期六，莉莉感到緊張，因為她有一場棒球比賽。

sentences.en: She warms up with her team, and they cheer each other.
sentences.zh: 她和隊友一起熱身，互相加油。

sentences.en: Lily is a polite player, and she always listens to her coach.
sentences.zh: 莉莉是個有禮貌的運動員，她總是聽從教練的指示。

sentences.en: During the game, she feels shy when the crowd laughs at her funny mistake.
sentences.zh: 比賽進行時，當觀眾笑她的有趣錯誤時，莉莉感到害羞。

sentences.en: But her friend Tom says, “Don’t worry, it’s just fun!” and gives her a ball.
sentences.zh: 但她的朋友湯姆說：「別擔心，這只是很有趣！」並給她一個球。

sentences.en: After the game, they go to the park to play basketball and tennis for exercise.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，他們去公園打籃球和網球來運動。

sentences.en: Lily thinks sport is her hobby, and she makes it a habit to practice every week.
sentences.zh: 莉莉認為運動是她的嗜好，她養成每週練習的習慣。

sentences.en: Sometimes she feels bored when it rains, but she reads a quiet book to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 有時候下雨時她會感到無聊，但她會讀一本安靜的書來保持平靜。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, Lily feels happy because she was careful and did her best.
sentences.zh: 一天結束時，莉莉感到開心，因為她很小心，並且盡力而為。

sentences.en: When Lily forgot her baseball glove, she was in trouble, but her teammate lent her one.
sentences.zh: 當莉莉忘記帶棒球手套時，她陷入麻煩，但隊友借給她一個。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① How do you feel? – 用來問感覺
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用這個句型詢問對方現在的感受，答案通常是 I feel + 形容詞。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② I feel…because… – 說明感覺的原因
grammar_points.explain_zh: 在 I feel … 後面加 because + 原因句子，說明為什麼有這種感覺。

examples.en: I feel excited because today we have a baseball game.
examples.zh: 我感到興奮，因為今天我們有棒球賽。

examples.en: I feel shy because I have to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 我感到害羞，因為我必須在全班面前說話。

examples.en: I feel tired because I exercised for an hour.
examples.zh: 我感到疲倦，因為我運動了一個小時。

examples.en: I feel happy because my team won the match.
examples.zh: 我感到開心，因為我的隊伍贏得了比賽。

dialogue.title_zh: 情境對話：準備棒球賽前的感覺

lines.en: How do you feel before the baseball game?
lines.zh: 艾米，你在棒球賽前感覺怎麼樣？

lines.en: I feel nervous because I am the player.
lines.zh: 我感到緊張，因為我是運動員。

lines.en: I feel excited because I get to cheer for the team.
lines.zh: 我感到興奮，因為我可以為隊伍加油。

lines.en: Do you feel shy when you stand in front of the crowd?
lines.zh: 你站在人群前會感到害羞嗎？

lines.en: A little, but I feel happy when we play sport together.
lines.zh: 有一點，但我們一起做運動時我感到很開心。

sentences.en: How do you feel after school?
I feel bored because the lesson is too boring.
sentences.zh: 我感到無聊，因為課堂太無聊。

sentences.en: She feels shy when she has to speak in front of the class.
sentences.zh: 她在全班面前說話時會感到害羞。

sentences.en: He feels nervous before the tennis match.
sentences.zh: 他在網球賽前感到緊張。

sentences.en: We feel excited because we get to play basketball, have fun, exercise our hobby, and practice our habit of teamwork.
sentences.zh: 我們感到興奮，因為我們可以打籃球、玩得開心、練習嗜好，並培養團隊合作的習慣。

sentences.en: I feel troubled because I lost my ball, but it's funny to look for it.
sentences.zh: 我感到困擾，因為我遺失了球，但找球的過程很有趣。

sentences.en: She feels polite when she says thank you to her teacher.
sentences.zh: 她在對老師說謝謝時感到有禮貌。

sentences.en: He feels careful when he crosses the busy street.
sentences.zh: 他在過繁忙的街道時感到小心。
